pipeline.asset: Anti-Viral Central Memory CD8+ Veto Cells
pipeline.target: Selective immune attenuation; veto cell mechanism enabling haploidentical T-cell-depleted HSCT without GvHD
pipeline.license_origin: Exclusive license from Yeda Research and Development (Weizmann Institute); inventor Prof. Yair Reisner now at MD Anderson

indications.indication: Hematologic malignancies receiving haploidentical hematopoietic stem cell transplantation (HSCT)
indications.trial_name: Cytokine-Treated Veto Cells in Treating Patients With Hematologic Malignancies Following Stem Cell Transplant
indications.trial_design: Open-label dose-escalation Phase 1/2 of cytokine-treated anti-viral veto cells administered with reduced-intensity-conditioning haploidentical HSCT; primary objectives engraftment without GvHD and optimal veto-cell dose; pediatric and adult (12-75 yrs)
indications.trial_status: Active, not recruiting (started Aug 2019; estimated completion Dec 2027). Per 10-K, first 5 cohorts (15 patients each) completed with no Veto-Cell-related toxicity and consistent engraftment.
indications.lead_sponsor: M.D. Anderson Cancer Center (10-K states trial is sponsored/funded by Cell Source)
key_milestones: First 10 patients in initial protocol achieved primary endpoints; subsequent cytokine-treated cohorts ongoing

excluded_preclinical.asset: Veto Cell for sickle cell anemia / Type 1 diabetes / autoimmune (non-HSCT settings)

summary_counts.note: 1 P1/2 asset; counted under P2 as the higher phase
